verdict.rationale: Zep ships an official, documented CLI, zepctl, for administering Zep projects. The docs say it gives full access to users, threads, Context Graphs and data operations from the terminal, and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. missing for 10: details on installation and the command reference, evidence of AI/agent-oriented features (e.g., machine-readable output or non-interactive scripting), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
